version.changelog: Fix plugin install: publish full plugin package with package.json, openclaw.extensions, index.ts, hooks, and skill

llm.summary: The skill's code, runtime instructions, and requirements are consistent with a local LAN UDP messenger for agent-to-agent communication and do not request unrelated credentials or external installs.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the bundled code and SKILL.md: the plugin opens a UDP socket, discovers peers, sends/receives messages, and manages trusted peers. Required binary (node) is appropriate and no unrelated credentials, binaries, or config paths are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md and CLAUDE.md instruct the agent to discover, receive, approve, and send messages and explicitly require user approval for untrusted peers. The included hook prompts checking inbox before stopping. The instructions do not ask the agent to read unrelated files, environment variables, or contact external services.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: This is instruction-only with an embedded TypeScript plugin in the package; SKILL.md references installing the GitHub repo but the plugin code is included in the bundle. No downloads from untrusted URLs or archive extraction are present in the provided files.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No environment variables, secrets, or external service credentials are requested. The plugin uses local network interfaces and generates a local agentId; these are proportional to its purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Skill does not request always:true and does not modify other skills' configs. It registers tools and binds a UDP socket for the agent instance—expected for this functionality. Model invocation is allowed by default (normal).
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This plugin appears to do exactly what it says: facilitate local UDP messaging between agents. Before installing, consider: (1) only enable this on trusted LANs or use the recommended always-confirm trustMode to avoid automatic message delivery from approved peers; (2) review the plugin source (included here) for any changes before enabling; (3) avoid sending secrets or file contents over UDP unless you explicitly authorize it; (4) if you run agents in sensitive environments, consider firewall rules or restricting the port to mitigate unintended data leaks. Overall the package is coherent, but network-facing capabilities always carry risk if misused.
